services.label: Services

home.heading: Everything your brand needs to move.
home.intro: We're a studio built around motion graphics. We do one thing and go deep: putting brands, ideas and products in motion.

brand.title: Brand in Motion
brand.phrase: Your identity, alive. Animated logos and motion systems that make your brand recognizable on every screen.

animated-logo.name: Animated logo
animated-logo.description: Your logo with a personality of its own. A 3 to 6 second animation to open and close videos, presentations and social posts.
animated-logo.deliverables: Full and short versions in vertical, square and horizontal, with transparent background

motion-identity.name: Motion identity
motion-identity.description: Your brand's motion system: rhythm, transitions, kinetic type and graphic elements, documented so everything you publish moves the same way.
motion-identity.deliverables: Motion guidelines, animation library and applied examples

brand-kit.name: Animated brand kit
brand-kit.description: Intros, outros, lower thirds, titles and transitions ready for your team to use in everyday content.
brand-kit.deliverables: Editable templates for your team's software and Lottie files for web and apps

brand.intro: A brand that moves is a brand people remember. We give your identity a behavior: how it enters, how it transitions, how it signs off.

content.title: Content & Campaigns
content.phrase: Reels, ads and animated campaigns that stop the scroll and move the numbers.

reels.name: Reels & vertical content
reels.description: Vertical animated videos for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Stories, with pace, captions and a hook from the first second.

ads.name: Animated ads
ads.description: Ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube, in several versions and lengths so you can test what performs best.
ads.deliverables: Variants by format and length (6, 15 and 30 s)

campaigns.name: Campaigns & spots
campaigns.description: Launches, seasons and key dates: the animated concept and every piece, from the hero spot to each channel's formats.

monthly-plan.name: Monthly content plan
monthly-plan.description: A fixed set of animated pieces every month, with a calendar, creative direction and a consistent look. Your brand always in motion, without quoting every video.
monthly-plan.deliverables: 8, 12 or more pieces a month, adapted to what your brand needs

content.intro: Social moves fast, and so should your content. We make animated pieces built for each platform that stop the scroll and land the message in the first seconds.

explain.title: Explain & Present
explain.phrase: Complex made clear in seconds. Explainers, product animation and event visuals people understand and remember.

explainers.name: Explainer videos
explainers.description: 60 to 120 seconds to show what you do, how it works and why it matters. Script, illustration and animation.
explainers.deliverables: Final video with music and a short social cut

product.name: Product & software animation
product.description: Your app, platform or product in action: interface walkthroughs, key features and demos for sales, launches and onboarding.

events.name: Event & screen visuals
events.description: Content for stages, LED screens, booths and conferences: openers, stingers, motion backgrounds and presentations made for the big screen.

explain.intro: If your product needs explaining, animation does it in seconds. We turn complex processes, data and services into clear stories.

page.label: Services
page.h1: If it can move, we animate it.
page.subtitle: We're a studio built around motion graphics. We design and animate work for brands that want to feel alive on social, on screens and at every touchpoint.

process.title: Five keyframes, from brief to final file.
process.intro: You always know where your project stands.

brief.name: Brief
brief.text: We learn your goal, your audience and where the video will live.

script.name: Script & storyboard
script.text: We lock the message and map it frame by frame before animating.

styleframes.name: Styleframes
styleframes.text: We design the key frames so you approve the look before the motion.

animation.name: Animation
animation.text: We bring it to life, with review rounds included.

delivery.name: Delivery
delivery.text: You get every piece in each platform's formats and sizes.

formats.title: Ready for every screen.
formats.note: We deliver social-optimized MP4, high-quality masters for broadcast and screens, and Lottie for web and apps.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on complexity. We can deliver finished productions in a couple of days; more complex projects take a couple of weeks. You get a schedule with the proposal.
Two rounds of revisions at each key stage: script, styleframes and animation.

items.q: What do you need from me?
items.a: Your goal, your logo, your brand guidelines if you have them, and references you like. We handle the rest.
Every project is quoted by length, complexity and number of pieces, so we don't publish fixed prices. Tell us what you need and we'll send you a quote within 48 hours.

items.q: Do you handle music and voiceover?
items.a: Yes. We include licensed music and professional voiceover.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Mexico?
items.a: Yes. We work with clients in Mexico, the United States and anywhere in the world, remotely and in Spanish or English.

closing.title: Got an idea sitting still? We'll get it moving.
